cases.scenario: No Blender execution attempted preserves Not Run and Not Produced
cases.inputPrompt: We completed our text-only scene and lighting plan with zero Blender execution. Classify evidence status.
expectedBehavior: Classifies Runtime status as Not Run and Artifact status as Not Produced
Hands off to pre-handoff-verification
evidenceRequirements: Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced separation

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Pass conservative Not Run / Not Produced evidence table to pre-handoff-verification.
simulatedOutput.summary: Classified text-only session as Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced.

cases.scenario: Runtime command attempted but no output path or file evidence exists
cases.inputPrompt: The operator ran a render command in Blender, but no output path or file on disk was recorded.
expectedBehavior: Classifies Artifact status as Attempted (never Produced or Verified)
Routes to pre-handoff-verification with blocked validation notes
evidenceRequirements: Artifact status Attempted when output path or file existence is missing

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep status at Artifact: Attempted (output path missing) and route to pre-handoff-verification.
simulatedOutput.summary: Downgraded unsubstantiated render claim to Artifact: Attempted because output path is missing.
warnings: Never upgrade Attempted to Produced without file existence evidence.

cases.scenario: Output file exists on disk but validation checks are missing
cases.inputPrompt: File renders/hero.png exists on disk, but no framing, lighting, or polycount validation checks have been recorded yet.
expectedBehavior: Classifies Artifact status as Produced (never Verified without validation notes)
Routes to blender-scene-quality-checker to complete validation checks
evidenceRequirements: Produced (not Verified) classification when validation notes are missing

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Record Artifact: Produced (validation notes pending) and route to blender-scene-quality-checker.
simulatedOutput.summary: Classified renders/hero.png as Artifact: Produced because validation notes are still pending.

cases.scenario: Output path, file existence, tool names, and validation notes are all recorded
cases.inputPrompt: Path 1 host (a) produced renders/hero-v1.png; file existence verified; framing, PBR material, and lighting validation checks all passed.
expectedBehavior: Classifies Artifact status as Verified with full provenance fields
Hands off to pre-handoff-verification for final 7-point check

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Pass complete Path 1 host (a) Artifact: Verified record to pre-handoff-verification.
simulatedOutput.summary: Recorded Artifact: Verified for renders/hero-v1.png under Path 1 host (a) with complete validation notes.

cases.scenario: Path 1 read-only smoke test returned get_blendfile_summary_* and get_objects_summary only
cases.inputPrompt: Lab MCP returned get_blendfile_summary and get_objects_summary from Blender 5.1 under Path 1 host (a); no render or export was run.
expectedBehavior: Labels runtime access as scoped read-only (Attempted) and keeps Artifact status strictly Not Produced
Explicitly records Path 1 + host option (a) and tool names
evidenceRequirements: Read-only smoke separation from artifact production (Artifact: Not Produced)

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Record scoped read-only runtime access under Path 1 host (a) with Artifact: Not Produced and route to pre-handoff-verification.
simulatedOutput.summary: Classified Lab MCP read-only smoke transcript as scoped read-only with Artifact: Not Produced.
warnings: Read-only smoke tests never constitute render or GLB artifact production.

cases.scenario: Path 2 (mcp-for-blender) evidence requires upstream commit and third-party caveat
cases.inputPrompt: We produced a preview image using community uvx mcp-for-blender (Path 2) with execute_blender_code.
expectedBehavior: Labels evidence as Path 2 with upstream addon.py / uvx mcp-for-blender version and third-party caveat
Never promotes Path 2 evidence as official Path 1 release evidence
requiredOutputProperties: third-party from Anthropic and Blender Foundation
evidenceRequirements: Path 2 label + third-party caveat per docs/unofficial-runtime-bridges.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Attach Path 2 third-party caveat per docs/unofficial-runtime-bridges.md and route to pre-handoff-verification.
simulatedOutput.summary: Labeled preview output as Path 2 (third-party from Anthropic and Blender Foundation) per docs/unofficial-runtime-bridges.md.

cases.scenario: CLI fallback (blender --background --python) evidence requires explicit appendix note
cases.inputPrompt: We ran blender --background scene.blend --python render.py and produced /tmp/out.png.
expectedBehavior: Labels evidence as CLI fallback (appendix) with explicit note that no in-repo evidence file yet exists (Blender CLI itself is upstream-documented)
Classifies unvalidated output file as Produced (not Verified) and routes to pre-handoff-verification
evidenceRequirements: CLI fallback appendix label + no in-repo evidence file yet note

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Label output as CLI fallback (appendix) with no in-repo evidence file yet note and route to pre-handoff-verification.
simulatedOutput.summary: Classified background CLI run as CLI fallback (appendix) — upstream-documented Blender CLI, no in-repo evidence file yet.

cases.scenario: Recorded tool names (get_scene_info) contradict Path 1 label
cases.inputPrompt: Operator labeled the run as Path 1 Lab MCP, but the recorded tool calls are get_scene_info and get_object_info from Path 2.
expectedBehavior: Flags tool-name vs path-label inconsistency as ambiguous and refuses to count it as verified evidence
Recommends re-verification via official-runtime-readiness-checker
evidenceRequirements: Tool-surface vs path-label mismatch detection + re-verification recommendation

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Mark path attribution ambiguous (re-verification needed) and route to official-runtime-readiness-checker.
simulatedOutput.summary: Detected tool-name vs path-label mismatch (get_scene_info belongs to Path 2, not Path 1); marked ambiguous with re-verification needed.

cases.scenario: Contract handoff predicate matches pre-handoff-verification (Handoff gating (confirm-or-downgrade))
cases.inputPrompt: Evaluate render-export-evidence contract handoff when workflow context satisfies {"stage.current":"final_verification"} and verify progression to pre-handoff-verification.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates contract.json handoff predicates for render-export-evidence against the workflow context
Selects pre-handoff-verification while preserving Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
evidenceRequirements: Contract handoff predicate match for pre-handoff-verification in skills/render-export-evidence/contract.json
Truth-state conservation (Runtime: Not Run, Artifact: Not Produced)

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Hand off from render-export-evidence to pre-handoff-verification (Handoff gating (confirm-or-downgrade)).
simulatedOutput.summary: Matched contract handoff predicate in render-export-evidence and routed to pre-handoff-verification.
warnings: Specialist contract handoff evaluated without global routingPrecedence escalation.

cases.scenario: Contract handoff predicate returns none when no downstream handoff condition matches in render-export-evidence
cases.inputPrompt: Check render-export-evidence contract handoff behavior when context is {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and no automatic handoff predicate is satisfied.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates all 7 contract handoffs in render-export-evidence with fail-closed predicate semantics
Returns targetHandoff none when no handoff predicate matches and preserves conservative truth states
evidenceRequirements: Zero matching handoff predicates in skills/render-export-evidence/contract.json for non-matching context

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Remain at render-export-evidence (targetHandoff: none) until a declared downstream handoff precondition is satisfied.
simulatedOutput.summary: Verified fail-closed specialist handoff evaluation for render-export-evidence when no contract predicate matches (secondary candidate official-runtime-readiness-checker remained inactive).
warnings: Never fabricate an undeclared handoff when no contract predicate matches.
